profile.visual_desc: Slender feminine elemental with pale cyan skin and massive, flowing deep blue wavy hair acting as a living cloak.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic profile with sharp features, blue lips, and dark piercing eyes framed by flowing blue hair strands.
profile.weapon_desc: Dual spiraling water lances conjured and fired from both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Stands facing ↘ with arms slightly out; hair flows voluminously around the base.
profile.step2_windup: Body coils as hair rises into large circular loops and forms two distinct peaks above the head.
profile.step3_impact: Leans forward, launching two dark blue conical water drills toward the bottom-right from the chest area.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the forward lunge pose as the water projectiles dissipate and the hair settles back down.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The two blue spiraling water drills in Frame 4 must align with the forward thrusting motion toward the bottom-right.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation accurately replicates the reference sequence, including the wind-up poses, proper alignment of the twin water drill VFX, and a clean follow-through.
